plan.phase: cycle4 positive SET only, both chronological branches
plan.scope: Same-cycle observed-current inversion is a fixed-spectrum/fixed-transistor-table diagnostic, not a prediction or material-law-wide rejection.
plan.native_selection: Nearest sample in declared branch must be within3e-7V; record mismatch and do not interpolate observed current.
plan.inverse: Invert the same monotone piecewise-linear transistor lookup, then invert the same log-bilinear material table at measured local voltage; no extrapolation.
plan.pair: Outward2V precedes return4V; positive mobility requires u_out2>=u_return4.
plan.tradeoff: Only if target states violate order, use the shared-u equal-and-opposite log-current-error root to obtain the optimistic minimum maximum log error. This is an analytic order relaxation, not an ODE fit or an optimizer.
plan.band_scope: Original32-record return4V empirical band plus previously declared outward2V lower anchor. The latter is identified separately, not relabelled a primary aggregate gate.
